abandoned_cart.title: An Abandoned Cart
abandoned_cart.body: A broken cart rests beside the road. Its owner is nowhere to be seen.

quiet_road.title: A Quiet Stretch of Road
quiet_road.body: The road is quiet. It must be safe to continue?

roadside_corpse.title: A Body Beside the Road
roadside_corpse.body: A traveller lies beside the road. Their coat is torn and their belongings are scattered through the grass. You stop to consider whether to search the remains.
